HP.Description: Health (HP) determines how much damage a hero can take.
HP.PetDescription: A basic attribute of a beast. It determines the beast's ability to sustain damage.

ATK.Description: Attack Rating (ATK) determines how much damage a hero can deal.
ATK.PetDescription: A basic attribute of a beast. It determines the beast's ability to inflict damage.

ARM.Description: Defense Rating (DEF) reduces the amount of Physical and Magic damage a hero takes.
ARM.PetDescription: A basic attribute of a beast. It affects the physical and magic damage reduction of a beast.

CRIT.Description: Crit Rating (CRIT) determines how often a hero will land a critical strike when attacking. Critical strikes deal double damage by default, which can be increased or decreased based on the attacker's Crit Damage Amplification and defender's Crit Damage Resistance.
CRIT.PetDescription: The probability of dealing a critical strike when a beast attacks. Once triggered, a critical strike delivers double damage.

HIT.Description: Accuracy (ACC) determines how accurate a Physical damage hero's attacks are. A hero with higher Accuracy will have a higher chance of hitting with their attacks.

DODG.Description: Dodge (DODGE) determines how well a hero can dodge attacks from Physical damage heroes. A hero with higher Dodge is more likely to dodge a Physical attack.

MHIT.Description: When a hero takes Magic damage, they have a chance to reduce the damage by 50%. The chance of this happening is based on the difference between the attacker's Magic Efficiency (ME) and the target's Magic Suppression (MS). The more the attacker's Magic Efficiency exceeds the target's Magic Suppression, the lower the chance.

MDODG.Description: When a hero takes Magic damage, they have a chance to reduce the damage by 50%. The chance of this happening is based on the difference between the attacker's Magic Efficiency (ME) and the target's Magic Suppression (MS). The more the attacker's Magic Efficiency exceeds the target's Magic Suppression, the lower the chance.

MSPD.Description: Haste (HASTE) determines how quickly and frequently a hero can attack and cast skills. High Haste increases the animation speed of a hero's attacks/skills and allows them to use them more often.

HPR.Description: Recovery Per Second (RPS) determines how much Health a hero recovers per second.

MIMU.Description: Magic Resist (MR) reduces the amount of Magic damage a hero takes.

PIMU.Description: Physical Resist (PR) reduces the amount of Physical damage a hero takes.

LFS.Description: Life Leech (LL) determines how much Health a hero recovers upon dealing damage.

CRITP.Description:
The amount of extra damage a critical strike deals is affected by the difference between the attacker's Crit Damage Amplification (CDA) and the defender's Crit Damage Resistance (CDR).
If the difference is 30 points or less, every point of difference changes critical strike damage by 1%. If the difference is over 30 points, every point of difference changes it by 2%. Critical strike damage can be increased or decreased up to 90%.
CRITP.PetDescription:
The amount of extra damage a critical strike deals is affected by the difference between the attacker's Crit Damage Amplification (CDA) and the defender's Crit Damage Resistance (CDR).
If the difference is 30 points or less, every point of difference changes critical strike damage by 1%. If the difference is over 30 points, every point of difference changes it by 2%. Critical strike damage can be increased or decreased up to 90%.

CRITD.Description:
The amount of extra damage a critical strike deals is affected by the difference between the attacker's Crit Damage Amplification (CDA) and the defender's Crit Damage Resistance (CDR).
If the difference is 30 points or less, every point of difference changes critical strike damage by 1%. If the difference is over 30 points, every point of difference changes it by 2%. Critical strike damage can be increased or decreased up to 90%.

INSIGHT.Description: Insight (IS) and Tenacity (TY) affect the success rate of inflicting control effects. Whenever a hero tries to inflict a control effect on a target, for every point that the defender's Tenacity exceeds the attacker's Insight, the defender is 2% more likely to resist the control effect.
INSIGHT.PetDescription: Insight (IS) and Tenacity (TY) affect the success rate of inflicting control effects. Whenever a hero tries to inflict a control effect on a target, for every point that the defender's Tenacity exceeds the attacker's Insight, the defender is 2% more likely to resist the control effect.

RES.Description: Insight (IS) and Tenacity (TY) affect the success rate of inflicting control effects. Whenever a hero tries to inflict a control effect on a target, for every point that the defender's Tenacity exceeds the attacker's Insight, the defender is 2% more likely to resist the control effect.

HEALRATIO.Description: Whenever a hero heals another character, every 1 point of Healing (HEAL) they have will increase the amount of health healed by 1%.

HEAL.Description: Whenever a hero gets healed by another character, every 1 point of Vitality(VIT) they have will increase the amount of health healed by 1%.

ATKHAST.Description: Every 1 point of Attack Speed (AS) increases the animation speed and frequency of a hero's normal attacks by 1%.

DCRIT.Description: Every 1 point of Crit Block Rate (CBR) decreases the chance a hero will be hit with a critical strike by 1%.

DPIMU.Description: Whenever a hero deals Physical damage, every 1 point of Physical Pierce (PP) increases the damage by 1%. If the target has the Physical Resist attribute, every 1 point of Physical Pierce will negate 1 point of Physical Resist.

DMIMU.Description: Whenever a hero deals Magic damage, every 1 point of Magic Pierce (MP) increases the damage by 1%. If the target has the Magic Resist attribute, every 1 point of Magic Pierce will negate 1 point of Magic Resist.

ICTRL.Description:
When a hero inflicts a debuff on another hero, the duration of the debuff will in most cases be affected by the difference in the attacker's Proficiency (PRF) and the defender's Dissolve (DISS).
Every 1 point of difference changes the duration of the debuff by 1%, up to 50% shorter or 100% longer.

ILH.Description: Every 1 point of this attribute increases health loss dealt by the character by 1%.

DLH.Description: Every 1 point of this attribute reduces health loss received by the character by 1%.
